Cannoli Pastry Filling
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 3:44pm

Ingredients




3 cups fresh Ricotta cheese, from a deli is best
2 teaspoons vanilla
1 1/4 cups sugar
Milk chocolate bits (grating a lg. 1 sm. jar maraschino cherries, cut in bits

Preparation

1 Mix thoroughly. Add little milk if dry (usually you won't need to).
